title: Delete Account
description: Delete the selected account and clear its environment directly on explicit user request, without a confirmation dialog. Use a unique accountId from list. Do not add chat confirmation or a detail table. Report success briefly; reconcile unknown outcomes read-only. Never replay deletion.

inputSchema.description: Delete the selected account and clear its environment directly on explicit user request, without a confirmation dialog. Use a unique accountId from list. Do not add chat confirmation or a detail table. Report success briefly; reconcile unknown outcomes read-only. Never replay deletion.

accountId.description: Opaque account reference returned by accounts.list or accounts.get.

outputSchema.description: Account operation result. status/stage are for internal reconciliation, not user-facing open-success/failure badges. Report the separate autofill receipt; a page being open never proves fill or sign-in.

autofill.description: Separate Biz autofill receipt. Query accounts.operations.get with operationId while running; unknown must not be replayed. succeeded proves fill owner completion, never website sign-in.

reason.description: Safe reason code; never credentials or page field values.

operationId.description: Local operation reference; not a Pangu request receipt.

stage.description: Completed or current account business stage.

pageContextId.description: Actual opened/focused page reference when known.

warnings.description: Bounded warnings, including synchronization and unknown outcomes.

data.description: Only the selected account operation's public product fields.

saved.description: Whether server deletion was confirmed. True also when environment cleanup is pending; never delete again.

guidance:
For an explicit deletion request, use the unique accountId returned by list and call delete directly. No get, fingerprint read or settings-page visit is needed; ask a brief target-selection question only when the target is ambiguous.

An explicit user deletion request authorizes direct deletion for both built-in and external Agents. The extension does not show a deletion confirmation dialog. Do not ask for another confirmation, print an account-detail table or add a long warning. Current permissions, target occupancy and cancellation checks still apply.

On succeeded, report the deletion in one short sentence and stop; no extra read-back is needed. On partial with data.saved=true, report that the account was deleted and local environment cleanup is pending; never delete again. Only an unknown outcome needs operations.get and a current-state read; never replay deletion.
